description: a unit cylinder (radius 1, z -1..1) fused with a cylinder of radius 2 (z -0.5..0.5) centred at y = -1, so the unit cylinder lies inside it and touches its wall along the line x = 0, y = 1. The closed forms: V = 2 pi + (4 pi - pi) = 5 pi; A = unit side 2 pi (the two ends outside the slab) + unit caps 2 pi + the big wall 4 pi (the tangent line has no area) + the big caps 2 (4 pi - pi) = 14 pi; centroid y = 3 pi (-4/3) / 5 pi = -4/5. Arris builds V = 5 pi and drops the tangent ruling from the walls, but each outer cap is a crescent, its rim and the section circle touching at (0, 1, +-0.5), written as an outer loop and a hole that meet at no vertex: the body fails the checker (L5, loops 0 and 1 intersect). The desired result is one loop through the touch vertex twice, Full-green (plans/tangency-faults step 2). Open CASCADE imprints the tangent line, so its shape has genus 1 where the body is genus 0; step 2 states Arris's counts under counts_differ
